modules.name: Weighted
modules.description: Weighted quantizer: random CV in, notes out, with strong scale degrees chosen more often. Profiles from music research and gamelan pathet, with Focus, accents, step preference and slendro/pelog tunings

modules.name: The Changes
modules.description: Chord sequencer: picks the next chord the way the chosen style plays it, with the style's usual extensions, voice-led. Leads Weighted over the HARM cable and follows Long Form over LINK
